settings.heading: Delivered across the island
settings.text: Everything you need to know about getting your order, and what to do if something is not right.

settings.heading: Delivery
settings.note: Questions about a delivery? Write to us by email or on WhatsApp.

settings.label: Cost
settings.value: Rs 100 per order. Free when your order is above Rs 1,500.

settings.label: When
settings.value: Usually 1 to 3 working days after your order is confirmed.

settings.label: Collection
settings.value: By arrangement in Mon Gout. Contact us by email or on WhatsApp and we will agree a time.

settings.label: Payment
settings.value: By card at checkout. Card payments are processed by MIPS.

settings.label: Unopened
settings.value: Unopened products in their original packaging can be returned within seven days of delivery. Send us a message with your order number and the reason, and we will arrange it.

settings.label: Opened
settings.value: Opened skincare cannot be returned, for hygiene reasons, unless it is faulty or not what you ordered.

settings.label: Refunds
settings.value: Once we have the product back and have checked it, we refund you on the card you paid with.
